worked_solution:
Both the numerator and denominator approach $\infty $ as $x\to \infty .$ However, since ${x}^{2}≫\operatorname{ln}⁡x$ for large values of $x,$ the denominator is growing much faster than the numerator. Consequently, we conclude that

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡x}{{x}^{2}}=0.
$$
